title: AgentEnvelope
description: Universal wrapper/envelope for all BibleFi agent payloads. Every message exchanged between BibleFi agents must be wrapped in this envelope.

envelope_id.description: Unique identifier for this envelope instance.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the envelope schema being used.

payload_type.description: Discriminator indicating the type of payload contained in this envelope.

payload.description: The actual payload object. Must conform to the schema indicated by payload_type.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that issued this envelope. May be a DID, address, or service name.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this envelope was issued.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation identifier for tracing related envelopes across services.

trace_id.description: Optional distributed trace identifier (e.g. OpenTelemetry trace ID).

ttl_seconds.description: Optional time-to-live in seconds. Consumers should reject envelopes whose issued_at + ttl_seconds is in the past.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature over the canonical JSON serialization of the payload.

public_key.description: Hex- or base58-encoded public key corresponding to the signing key.

routing.description: Optional cross-chain routing metadata for bridge-aware message delivery.

source_chain_id.description: EIP-155 chain ID of the originating network.

target_chain_id.description: EIP-155 chain ID of the destination network.

bridge_protocol.description: Name of the bridge protocol used (e.g. 'LayerZero', 'Wormhole', 'Base Bridge').

gas_limit.description: Optional gas limit for the cross-chain message execution.
